{{Top|leg}}
'''''Farsi Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] that were used by the [[Dimok government]]. During the final stages of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Sepan campaign|Campaign]] to end the [[Sepan Civil War]]. '''Farsi Squadron''' was dispatched to attack the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]'' the attack was a failure and the Y-wings were destroyed in battle.
